Specifically, SOP 9.050,"Beyond-Use Dating (BUD) of Compounded Preparations" requires that expiration dates shall be assigned based on current drug stability information and sterility considerations. The procedure also requires that a reliable method fo r determining expiration date s shall be established, including laboratory testing of product stability, pyrogenicity, a nd chemical content when necessary.
